description:
Non-Material Amendment to planning permission
reference 230086 granted 29/09/23 for provision of the following changes: 




 Amendments to the proposed floorplan layouts to support
     new internal layouts, additional office space and servicing arrangements.
 External elevation amendments to facilitate recessed
     loading bays and undercroft access
 Façade treatment modifications including adjustments to
     window and door placements and the refinement of material colours, are
     proposed to align with revised internal layouts.
 Realignment of
     internal site footpaths, relocation of cycle shelters, and repositioning
     of crossings
 Landscape amendments to reallocate
     some of the tree locations, with no change in quantity
 Roof amendments to adjust the layout
     of the plant equipment, rooflights and PV location
